Color mezzotint on medium thick, gray-blue, moderately textured laid paper
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Private collection, gift, date unknown; Private collection, bequest, 1958 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Color mezzotint paper. A smooth river runs through a dark landscape. The sun, just below the horizon, illuminates the water and turns the sky orange and yellow. A dark tree is silhouetted against the sky.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Landscape)
